scope: All 1266 item rows from fixed client dump, including weapons, armor/accessories, consumables, ammo, quest/event/other and unnamed rows; no runtime loader or m1 changes.
method: Exact name-token candidates from both L1J name columns; explicit M1/M2 named correspondences reused for token changes. No graphic-only fallback.
Compare table/family, both names, blessing variants, client f5/f6 graphics and f10/f15 raw numeric values; preserve all collisions and original rows.

Confirm requested name-token + compatible-kind + raw f10 numeric value + BOTH f5/invgfx and f6/grdgfx correspondence. Confirmation does not decode human weight units, native grade, independently translate names, or choose one L1J variant. All original candidate payloads and SQL stats are retained.

Original scalar values, field presence, byte lengths, names and named_attributes are preserved; existing source JSONL retains omitted hashes/display-token metadata. Native fields are not newly decoded.
Native fields remain as supplied. f5 is the inventory icon. f15 is the proven aggregate factor; f26 enables division by 128. f10 weight equivalence and f4/f17/f32/f46 semantics remain unproven.

Client-only field status is explicit: validated f45 category code, f7 name token, f5 icon and code-confirmed f15 aggregate factor; raw f13/f17/f10/f6 are preserved separately from unconfirmed class/slot/weight/graphic meanings. Missing fields remain absent.

Unmapped reasons are fixed-reference token absence, unavailable client name token, or kind conflict. Same-family/f10/f5/f6 peers are diagnostic only and never added to candidates; classic-only and identity absence in L1J remain unknown.

grouping_policy.family: f48=1 -> weapon; else present f17 -> armor/accessories; other -> etc. Provisional organization, not new native semantic proof.
grouping_policy.kind: Non-equipment f45 uses name-based groups for food21/light22/potion1000,1001,1009/scroll1002,1004/wand1007,1013/container1008/ammo1010/spellbook1014; other stays etc. f45 absent is preserved absent.
grouping_policy.slot: Existing m1 slot_by_f17 candidate labels only for masks 1/2/4/8/32/64/256; other native slots stay unknown. Candidate stats use SQL type.
grouping_policy.grade: L1J bless 0/1/2 and armor.grade remain SQL reference values. Four-element correspondence can be confirmed while native grade and selected_l1j stay unknown/null.

checked: 648 original candidate payloads/raw SQL/stats/source references preserved; added correspondence metadata only
227 confirmed rows / 292 strict links / 258 candidate / 781 unmapped
58 multiple-variant confirmed rows retained without selection; grade and selected_l1j unchanged
client fact presence/status matches source; no class/slot/weight meaning invented
781 diagnoses against 2816 supplied SQL rows; structural peers are not candidates
JSON roundtrip, scoped counts, source wrappers and no product-path changes

prior_verification.command: Python -X utf8 -B -; inline stdin, no saved test tool
checked: 1266 unique IDs and full source-row coverage
all preserved native fields/names/named_attributes match source
648 candidate IDs/SQL lines/raw rows match source
SQL 2816 row column counts and quote/escape/comma parsing
weapon damage/hit and UI class ID column mapping

status_contract.field.status: confirmed=existing client code/dump fact; confirmed_raw=stored raw value only; candidate=local grouping; unknown=meaning/value unproven; absent=not supplied, never an inferred default.
